description: Every number the agent is allowed to cite MUST come from here (or RouteResult).

buildings_flooded.description: buildings whose max depth (3x3 around footprint) >= 0.15 m; at 30 m cells that is flood water within about 45 m, so read it as 'water close by'
buildings_flooded.title: Buildings Flooded

buildings_flooded_own_cell.description: buildings whose OWN cell's max depth >= 0.15 m: stricter than buildings_flooded (3x3), added in contract 0.4.0 (0 on older runs)
buildings_flooded_own_cell.title: Buildings Flooded Own Cell

road_km_impassable.description: road length with max depth >= passability threshold
road_km_impassable.title: Road Km Impassable

people_exposed.description: population in cells with max depth >= 0.15 m
people_exposed.title: People Exposed

boundary_outflow_m3.description: water leaving through the lagoon/edge boundary
boundary_outflow_m3.title: Boundary Outflow M3

mass_balance_error_pct.description: 100*(rain - drained - infiltrated - outflow - stored_end) / rain; solver sanity check, |err| should be < 1%
mass_balance_error_pct.title: Mass Balance Error Pct

is_surrogate.description: True if produced by the ML emulator, not the solver
is_surrogate.title: Is Surrogate

title: RunStats
